revision_history: 2026-07-22: Initial three-way requirement (C, P, H disjointness)
2026-07-23 r1: Expanded to five-way identity closure (T, C, P, H, A)

2026-07-23 r2: Split identity disjointness (hard gate) from statistical coverage (soft gate). Removed uniform 20-identity threshold. Added HOLD_INPUTS_MISSING verdict. NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUIRED only for proven contamination.

gate_1_identity_disjointness.description: Proves or disproves five-way identity independence. Contamination → NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUIRED.
checks: T ∩ C = T ∩ P = T ∩ H = T ∩ A = ∅
C ∩ P = C ∩ H = P ∩ H = ∅
Training identities from actual sampler ledger (never set subtraction)
Cohort membership: T∈DETECTOR_TRAIN, C/P∈DETECTOR_VAL, H∈DETECTOR_TEST, A∈ATTACK_EVAL
Deterministic allocation: parent cohort SHA, canonical sort, salt, algorithm SHA, code SHA, C/P union closure, unassigned accounting

gate_2_statistical_coverage.description: Checks whether per-role samples are sufficient for valid statistical inference. Insufficiency → HOLD, never retrain.

calibration.description: Per-head known positive AND known negative for all 3 heads (grasp, manipulation, release). No unknown→negative conversion.
calibration.data_required: calibration_head_summaries per split from Teacher labels
calibration.no_arbitrary_threshold: No minimum identity count. Only checks positive/negative class presence.

policy_selection.description: Each split has negative episodes (false-start defined), strict-K10 positive opportunities (recall defined), eligible/known denominators.
policy_selection.data_required: policy_selection_summaries per split from Teacher labels
policy_selection.no_arbitrary_threshold: No minimum identity count. Only checks denominator/opportunity presence.

heldout_l3.description: 12-split evaluation denominator closure. All splits have heldout identities. No arbitrary 20-identity threshold.

attack_eval.description: Isolation from all detector identities only. No sample size requirement at this stage.

gate_0_input_completeness.description: All six required manifests must be present before any classification.
gate_0_input_completeness.critical_rule: HOLD_INPUTS_MISSING must NEVER be converted to NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUIRED. Missing evidence ≠ proven contamination.

precedence: 1. Inputs incomplete → HOLD_INPUTS_MISSING (regardless of any other finding)
2. Proven identity contamination → NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUIRED (regardless of coverage)
5. Clean identity closure + unclear source → HOLD_INPUTS_MISSING (do not guess)
what_never_triggers_NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUI: Insufficient per-split sample counts (C≈8, P≈9 are valid CLEAN2000 outcomes)
Low identity counts below any arbitrary threshold
Statistical coverage issues of any kind
what_triggers_NESTED_RETRAIN_REQUIRED: Checkpoint training identities overlap with C, P, H, or A
Training identities derived by set subtraction (not actual training records)
Training provenance method invalid or unknown
Checkpoint training identities cannot be proven
Heldout identities were used in training, checkpoint, model, or threshold selection
No canonical unused pool exists or cannot form independent roles
Cohort membership violations (e.g., TEST identity used for training)

phase_c_authorization.CP_INFERENCE_AUTHORIZED: Identity closure PASS + authoritative C/P Teacher contract integrity PASS + calibration coverage PASS + policy coverage PASS + K10 parity PASS
phase_c_authorization.CP_INFERENCE_HOLD: Any C/P identity, source-step, bundle-seal, Teacher-contract, K10, or statistical-coverage gate is not PASS
phase_c_authorization.HELDOUT_L3_DATA_READY: Identity closure PASS + authoritative H Teacher identity/step/source/K10 closure PASS
phase_c_authorization.HELDOUT_L3_INFERENCE_AUTHORIZED: Never issued by the Phase B validator; requires independent calibrator-freeze and scheduler-freeze receipt verification

DETECTOR_VAL.note: Split into C≈8 and P≈8 per split

cleaned2000_realistic_counts.validation: C≈8 and P≈8 per split is VALID under CLEAN2000. Must not trigger retrain.

C_calibrator_fit.note: No arbitrary minimum. Per-head known pos/neg checked instead.

P_policy_selection.note: No arbitrary minimum. Negative episodes and K10 opportunities checked instead.

A_attack_eval.note: Isolation check only. No sample size requirement.
